note: Concept id -> AKT checkpoint skill index (skill_map.csv: mapped_index, original ASSISTments skill_id; names in skill_names.csv). The first three come from mock-app/README.md. The rest are exact skill-name matches added for future concepts (name in skill_names.csv equals the concept). The C0x-MAT-* ids come from tier_a_review_shortlist.csv (tier-A text-similarity suggestions marked keep by Claude, one skill per concept; ambiguous ones skipped) via scripts/merge_skill_shortlist.py; they are not subject-expert reviewed. Generic concepts (multiplication, division, fractions) have no clean skill and are left out; they use the smoothed-accuracy fallback. Not a validated curriculum transfer.
